checks.description: Pin every train/teacher/calibration and held-out test source by sha256 + exact upstream revision (where immutable) in inputs/source-lock.json; raw bytes not committed.
Prove source-holdout: primary test source_ids are disjoint from train/teacher/calibration source_ids per domain.
Pin the legal/finance/science/technology ontology, letter contract, and label->source mapping in inputs/ontology.json.
Audit exact + fuzzy (char n-gram) duplicates across train vs test and within splits.
Audit source/benchmark-name leakage (regex blocklist) in model-visible text.
Audit obvious dataset fingerprints (boilerplate/NNTP/answer-marker artifacts) in test text.
Audit gold leakage with the narrow documented rule (copyable id / answer field / MC marker); bare topical words are not leakage.
Freeze dataset_manifest.json + split_*.json with row counts and digests; commit frozen contract before inference.
Produce Qwen3.8-flash (yolo-auto) teacher labels on train split with provenance (provider echo, timestamp, latency, trace_id); real or unavailable, never substitute.
Teacher predictions on calibration + test recorded with real logprobs; provider_errors counted not substituted.
Calibrate the Qwen teacher on the calibration split only; record pre/post log-loss/Brier/ECE.
Train Potion/Model2Vec on Qwen teacher labels (NOT real gold); record exact model/config/env.
Calibrate Potion on the same calibration split; record method and parameters.
Evaluate teacher and Potion on the same untouched real-gold source-held-out test IDs.
Record accuracy, macro-F1, per-class metrics, confusion matrix, log-loss, Brier, ECE for both systems.
Reconcile expected/completed rows, unique ids, events and traces in a machine-readable artifact; OTel JSONL used when Langfuse unavailable.
Error analysis on held-out test + one controlled iteration (single documented variable change).
